CDA Mê Ly Display™

Inspired by the shape of old apricot trees in Mộc Châu

Thank you for downloading CDA Mê Ly Display.

This typeface was created by Cōllective Design Agency (CDA), drawing inspiration from the gnarled, weathered shapes of old apricot trees (Prunus armeniaca) in Mộc Châu — a mountainous province in Northern Vietnam known for its highlands and seasonal apricot blossoms.

CDA Mê Ly Display was originally created for Mơ Ly Apricot Liqueur - an alcoholic beverage venture between Cōllective Studio and Bản Cuisine.

----------------------
Included in this Package

Bold weight font files in:

OpenType (.OTF)
TrueType (.TTF)
Web (.WOFF2)

Suitable for:

Beverage & Spirits Branding
Packaging & Label Design
Editorial Design
Signage
Digital Communication

----------------------
A Small Request

If you create something meaningful with this typeface, we hope you'll take a moment to share the story behind it.

Every project becomes an opportunity to introduce more people to Vietnamese design, nature, and craftsmanship.

The apricot trees of Mộc Châu are more than a seasonal spectacle. They are a reminder that beauty shaped slowly, by time and terrain, can still find its way into a single typeface.

Thank you for helping that story continue.
